project.name: @receivablex/web
project.productType: Receivables financing and servicing workspace with a public product introduction

motion.accessibility: Reduced-motion media queries; native dialog focus and scoped cleanup

design.density: Compact product workspace; spacious brand introduction

must: Keep real wallet and financial command handlers unchanged
Use only actual API or clearly labelled recorded data
Support keyboard, reduced motion and narrow mobile screens
avoid: Invented APY, adoption statistics or charts
Decorative gradient text, glass, or repeated card grids
Display serif typography in operational UI

decisions.direction: Dimensional graphite workbench with mint document sheets
decisions.basis: User supplied Aave Pro, then explicitly rejected the flat sidebar-led reskin and requested structural depth and GSAP motion.
decisions.implementation: Separate product introduction at / from /dashboard. Replace the sidebar with a command dock, show actual receivables in a CSS-3D folio, and inspect records in a contextual sheet. Retain existing routes, financial handlers and real WalletButton.
decisions.scene: A servicer moves between receivable records and cash states; document depth distinguishes inspectable assets from accounting data.
decisions.referenceUse: Aave Pro observed for density, type scale and grouped data, not copied assets or market content.
decisions.catalogStatus: 21st context initialization and local review used. Catalog search attempted but login was unavailable; no hosted AI generation or catalog component installation. GSAP installed separately.
decisions.reviewStatus: Implemented locally for user review; not published or claimed user-approved.
